notes.title: You're Safe Here
notes.content:
[p]Hello everyone! [/p][p]First of all, thank you so much for all the amazing messages and support!
To be honest, we were aiming at 15k wishlists for the early access release, and it's pretty amazing to say we are already at... 40k!
Seeing this incredible level of support truly motivates us to deliver the best game we possibly can. [/p][p][/p][h2]Where we're at[/h2][p][/p][p]Before the holidays, we held our first private playtests that allowed us to confirm what works well but also pinpoint some needed improvements and changes.[/p][p]While players enjoyed the core mechanics and the universe, we decided to step up our ambitions for the game loop and the overall feeling of adventure. We want you to experience more memorable moments and enjoy a unique journey. [/p][p]In order to fulfill these ambitions, we are also changing our organization and are proud to announce that two of us have left our full-time jobs and will soon be working 100% on the game. [/p][p]Be aware that we still don't want to rush the game and we would like to make sure that everything is ready and enjoyable once out. It's for that reason that no due date is set for now. [/p][p][/p][h2]Sneak Peek[/h2][p][/p][p]We know it's already been a long time, and we are as eager as you are to show you what we've been working on. So here’s a short ambience video in the game lobby.[/p][p]We wanted to create a beautiful and lively environment, a place where you can chill while waiting for friends before diving into the unknown, or relax after a tough dive. [/p][p][/p][previewyoutube="Ih8QxWeOj5s;full"][/previewyoutube][p]We hope you like it![/p][p][/p][p]Thanks again for being part of this journey with us, and we’ll catch you in the next update.[/p][p]Have a wonderful day![/p]
